name: Qwen3.6-27B
summary: The dense sibling that 3.8-27B replaced. Kept in the directory because it is the cleanest A/B for the reported 3.8 regressions: same dense body, same serving stack, one generation apart.
notes: MTP head presence is unverified on this checkpoint. If boot rejects EAGLE speculative decoding, set SPEC_ENABLE=0 and relaunch.

practical_baseline.rationale: A reported quality-gated Q4 lane that remains within one 24 GB consumer GPU.
